designationHistory.name: Snake Creek National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: The refuge was established as Snake Creek National Wildlife Refuge on Corps of Engineers land to make up for bottomland habitat lost when Garrison Dam flooded the Missouri River.
designationHistory.note: FWS sources disagree: the web page says May 25, 1956; the 2008 CCP and the 2026 hunt documentation say 1955. No non-FWS source found. Renamed Audubon NWR in 1967 (CCP).
